title: Face Recognition Realtime — RetinaFace + ArcFace + FAISS + Anti-Spoofing

modules.dataset: Face ETL with 5-point landmark alignment (Umeyama similarity transform), synthetic face generator with identity-specific features (face shape, skin tone, eye/hair colour, facial hair), preprocess_for_arcface normalization to [-1,1].
modules.model: HaarFaceDetector (OpenCV cascade), ArcFaceEmbedder (lightweight ResNet backbone → 512-D L2-normalized embeddings), AntiSpoofingChecker (texture LBP + frequency FFT + color HSV heuristics), FaceVectorIndex (FAISS IndexFlatIP cosine similarity), FaceRecognitionPipeline (detect→align→embed→search end-to-end).
modules.train: argparse CLI: --n-identities, --n-images-per-identity, --detector, --spoof-threshold, --onnx-out, --metrics-json, --roc-plot, --retrieval-plot. Evaluates Top-1/Top-5 retrieval, verification ROC curve, anti-spoofing benchmark, and ONNX parity.
modules.tests: 13 tests: landmark transforms (identity/translation/rotation), face alignment shape, synthetic face determinism + balance, 512-D embedding L2 norm = 1.0, batch embedding shape, FAISS recall@1 = 1.0 for registered identities, FAISS index size, anti-spoofing score in [0,1], ONNX export + runtime parity (< 1e-3), CLI smoke test.
